# Synthetic demo results

**Synthetic data only.** Generated by `checkout_anomaly.synthetic`; the metrics measure how well
the detectors find the generator's own injected patterns, not real-world fraud.

Command: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 examples/run_synthetic_demo.py`  
Protocol: {"n_train": 5000, "n_test": 1000, "train_fraud_rate": 0.02, "test_fraud_rate": 0.1, "contamination": 0.15, "k": 150}  
Environment: {"python": "3.14.0", "numpy": "2.4.4", "pandas": "3.1.0", "scikit-learn": "1.8.0"}

## default_if_kmeans

Detectors: isolation_forest, kmeans_distance; seeds: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]; wall time 266 s

Mean over seeds (test set: 1,000 visits, 10 % injected fraud, so 100 positives):

```
                  roc_auc  average_precision  precision_at_150  recall_at_150  auc_skipped_scan  auc_under_priced  auc_scan_pause
method                                                                                                                           
isolation_forest    0.653              0.252             0.252          0.378             0.568             0.487           0.925
kmeans_distance     0.651              0.272             0.231          0.346             0.566             0.505           0.898
ensemble            0.656              0.278             0.237          0.356             0.570             0.490           0.927
```

Standard deviation over seeds:

```
                  roc_auc  average_precision  precision_at_150  recall_at_150  auc_skipped_scan  auc_under_priced  auc_scan_pause
method                                                                                                                           
isolation_forest    0.057              0.076             0.063          0.095             0.041             0.062           0.038
kmeans_distance     0.054              0.078             0.048          0.072             0.043             0.050           0.054
ensemble            0.056              0.079             0.062          0.092             0.036             0.062           0.040
```

Ensemble at the threshold fitted on training scores (85th percentile of train):

```
      flag_rate  precision  recall
mean      0.162      0.230   0.376
std       0.010      0.056   0.106
```
